title: Wealth Plan Checklist for High Earners
h1: Wealth plan checklist for high earners
keyLine: Export your own facts first. Then look at Preston's 12-month plan. Do not buy a plan you cannot describe on one page.
description: A wealth-plan checklist for high earners plus what Legacy Wealth Blueprint adds: Preston Seo's path, IRS 2026 figures, and free tools. No public tuition.
query: wealth plan checklist for high earners
answer: A wealth plan is a written order for your next dollar. It is not a vibe. High earners skip this and buy a course. Do the opposite. Pull statements. List debts. Note the 401(k) match. Legacy Wealth Blueprint is the 12-month format Preston Seo uses after a corporate job, a house-hacked duplex, and a $15M+ portfolio with his wife: a Wealth Strategy Snapshot, a dedicated guide, weekly coaching, and a CPA brief. This page is the worksheet you can finish without buying anything. We do not publish our tuition here. 2026 IRS 401(k) and HSA numbers are included so you can see empty room.

blocks.heading: What a finished plan looks like here
paragraphs: [Preston Seo](/about) started in debt in 2017, left a corporate path, and with his wife built a $15M+ portfolio. [Legacy Wealth Blueprint](/legacy-wealth-blueprint) turns a folder like this into a written Wealth Strategy Snapshot, then a year of a dedicated guide, weekly coaching, and a CPA Implementation Brief. You keep your CPA. You do not have to buy a rental on day one.
The checklist still works if you never buy Blueprint. Named client work is on [reviews](/reviews).

blocks.heading: Week one: export the facts
blocks.intro: Put these in one folder. That folder is the plan's raw material.
items: Last two pay stubs, with 401(k), HSA, and match lines highlighted.
Last year's federal return, or a transcript from IRS.gov if you cannot find it.
A list of debts: balance, rate, and minimum, from each statement.
Cash accounts: checking, savings, money market. Note any emergency fund in months of spend. Use the [emergency fund tool](/tools/emergency-fund-target) if you need a target.
Investment accounts: 401(k), IRA, brokerage. Write the balance only. Do not hunt for last year's return yet.
Insurance: health plan type (HSA-eligible or not), term life, disability if you have it.

blocks.heading: Score the leaks
paragraphs: Circle the largest leak. For many W-2 households it is tax plus lifestyle debt. For others it is cash sitting idle after accounts are full. Do not start a rental module to fix a 22% card.

2026 room you can measure: employee 401(k) deferral $24,500, extra $8,000 at age 50, extra $11,250 instead at ages 60 to 63 ([IRS IR-2025-111](https://www.irs.gov/newsroom/401k-limit-increases-to-24500-for-2026-ira-limit-increases-to-7500)). HSA $4,400 or $8,750 ([Rev. Proc. 2025-19](https://www.irs.gov/irb/2025-21_IRB)).

blocks.heading: A default order (change it with a CPA)
items: High-interest consumer debt and a basic cash buffer. Budget: [monthly budget planner](/tools/monthly-budget-planner).
401(k) at least to the match. Then HSA if you qualify.
Remaining 401(k) room vs taxable investing vs a rental. See [401(k) vs rental](/compare/401k-vs-rental-property).
Tax ideas that need a business or property only after the above is in writing. Start at [W-2 tax strategies](/tax-strategies/for/w2-employees).
Estate and insurance questions last, with the right licensed person. A course is not a will.

blocks.heading: Before any sales call
items: I can say my top leak in one sentence.
I know whether I still have 401(k) or HSA room.
I have a written price, refund rule, and who I will talk to.
I will not pay the fee with a card I cannot clear.
I read [what's in Blueprint](/compare/legacy-wealth-blueprint-what-to-know) if that is the call.

faqs.q: Is this a substitute for a financial planner?
faqs.a: No. It is a packet so a planner or CPA does not start from zero. You can stop after the packet.
Most of week one is gathering PDFs. The order in 'default order' can take an evening to draft and a year to live.

faqs.q: Do I need Legacy Wealth Blueprint to finish this?
faqs.a: No. Blueprint is one way to get a written snapshot and a guide. The checklist stands alone.

cta.title: Do the folder first
cta.body: If you want a coach to turn the folder into a 12-month snapshot, read Blueprint. If you only needed the order, stop here and use the tax hub.
